title: Flex Deck
slide_intent: Show variation within a repeated format because coherence need not require identical messages or imagery.
strategic_value: Adjacent text, mark and image panels can make Dropbox feel varied while remaining one campaign.
demonstration: A street-level wall carries five adjacent colored panels with text, abstract imagery and a central mark, framed by an annotated presentation board.
practical_value: Compare the roles of headline, artwork and signature across neighboring panels.

content_islands.name: Campaign run
content_islands.spec: Place the five-panel installation centrally within the pale board.

content_islands.name: Context
content_islands.spec: Retain the facade, street and small orange annotation to distinguish this analytical view from DB27.
